channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A Burlington man fell from a fishing boat into Lake Champlain near Kingsland Bay yesterday. Rescue teams have been searching but have not found him. The search will continue with additional Vermont State Police teams joining this morning.

Three hundred one acres in Newbury Vermont have been conserved forever by the Upper Valley Land Trust. The land provides important habitat for wildlife like bears and moose. It will remain open for public recreation and sustainable timber management.
A man died in a house fire on Kennedy Drive in Windsor yesterday morning. Fire crews and Vermont State Police are investigating the cause. Authorities say no foul play is suspected at this time.

Emergency responders from the Rutland Fire Department, Rutland City Police, and Regional Ambulance Service responded to a multi-vehicle rollover crash with entrapment this morning. The incident occurred at the intersection of South Main Street and Curtis Avenue due to slick road conditions. Fortunately, authorities reported that there were no serious injuries.
